title: Shared intrinsic basis + many Mirror task coordinates
hypothesis: At larger task counts, a shared intrinsic basis plus per-task Mirror addresses amortizes shared state and reduces total bytes versus independent random-subspace coefficients, while generic PCA may match the compression; independent task vectors reveal the private-coordinate boundary.
physical_object: frozen random projection U, D=256 to intrinsic d=32, shared across 64 tasks
mirror_coordinate: one shared intrinsic vector plus 64 per-task Givens angles
controls: shared Mirror vector and task-angle coordinates
generic rank-2 PCA of independently fitted intrinsic task coordinates

development.selection_metric: query NRMSE, total serialized payload bytes, marginal task-state bytes, optimizer updates and wall time

paid_objects: independent task coefficients or Mirror shared vector and angles
storage.report_both: full model+task payload and marginal task adaptation payload

success_gate: On aligned tasks, query NRMSE <=0.05 and at least 20% lower total bytes than independent coordinates; compute cost must be reported. Generic PCA matching Mirror means no Mirror-specific result. Independent stratum quantifies need for private coordinates.
failure_gate: No total-byte gain at matched quality or severe compute regression; independent tasks are the preregistered boundary condition.
boundaries: Random frozen U, not pretrained model
Aligned teacher tasks are generated from the tested Givens family
